verdict.rationale: Capacities documents one native recurring scheduled job: automated full exports configured under Settings > Full Export > Automated Full Export > Add Schedule. There is no evidence of general user-defined recurring workflows or scheduled AI/agent jobs. The REST API and MCP could be driven by an external scheduler, but those are developer building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: general-purpose recurring workflow or job scheduling, scheduled AI/agent tasks, configurable triggers and actions beyond exports, and independent corroboration.
